entries.en: Ah, such splendid timing! It would seem your singular ability to coax the great serpent into obedience with a mere whistle has made you quite the commodity. Uterl Matl was just asking after you, and requested that I send you his way with haste. The matter seemed quite urgent─so urgent, in fact, that he ran off before I had a chance to inquire as to the details!
entries.fr: Uterl Matl dire à Qhoterl Pasol qu'avoir besoin de charmeu<if(gnum4,se,r)> de Serpent marin<nbsp>! <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> être très bon<if(gnum4,ne,)> joueu<if(gnum4,se,r)> de flûûûte, alors aller voir ce que Uterl Matl vouloir<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ウテルリ・マトルが、水蛇様の魔笛を操ることのできる、
, ,1)>殿に用向きがあるそうで～。
事情までは存じませぬが、話を聞いてやってくださいましな～。

entries.en: Ah, good <if(gnum4,madam,sir)>, let me thank you for answering my summons on such short notice. My time spent with the great serpent has given me a certain intuition when it comes to anticipating its needs, and recently I've noticed something peculiar about its behavior.

entries.fr: Merci de venir jusqu'ici, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)><nbsp>! Uterl Matl avoir longuement fréquenté Serpent marin dans jarre, et croire avoir compris raison pour laquelle Serpent marin accorder bénédiction aux Qitari<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ご足労ありがとうございまする！
実は……壺入りの水蛇様との付き合いが長くなったおかげか、
最近、御心がわかるようになってきたのでございまする！

entries.en: It fidgets inside the vase restlessly, but I don't sense that it yearns for freedom. No, this is another matter entirely. It wishes to free something from within <italic(1)>itself<italic(0)>─doubtless that mystifying light it has a habit of disgorging from its eyes.

つい先ほども、つぶらな瞳で見つめられまして……。
おそらく水蛇様ゆかりの地である「水蛇の宝卵」にて、
思い切り「不思議な光」を放ちたいのでございましょう！

entries.en: I must admit I am grateful for the serpent's forbearance in the matter, when it is we who are obliged to serve. And serve we shall─with your help, of course. Pray bring the serpent to Fruit of the Protector, where it can shed light to its little heart's content.
entries.fr: Pour continuuuer à recevoir bénédiction divine, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> devoir aider Serpent marin à réaliser souhait en jouant flûte magique<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
その意図まではわかりかねまするが、
水蛇様が、そうしたいとお考えであれば、従うべきと存じまする！
魔笛を操り、「不思議な光」の力を解き放ってくだされ～！

entries.en: You've arrived just in time! The great serpent is full to bursting with that mysterious light, and I'd be loath to find out what happens were we to let it build up any further. Go on now, you know what to do.
entries.fr: Serpent marin être encore stressé... Pour continuuuer à recevoir bénédiction divine, <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> devoir jouer flûte magique pour aider Serpent marin à réaliser souhait et émettre lumière sacrée<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
今回も、水蛇様のストレス解消……いや失礼……
御身に溜まった、神秘の御力の解放を、お願いいたしまする！
魔笛を操り、「不思議な光」の力を解き放ってくだされ～！

entries.en: Best not leave the great serpent alone for too long─I dread to think what would happen if it was forced to contain itself any longer. Just blow on the whistle here and guide it to Fruit of the Protector so it can do what it needs to do.

entries.ja:
水蛇様の壺にお乗りになるのですね？
ロンカの魔笛はこちらにご用意しておりまする。
魔笛を操り、「不思議な光」の力を解き放ってくだされ～！

entries.ja:
まばゆい光と共に、神秘の力が放出された！
水蛇様は、何かをやり遂げた表情をしている……ように見える！

entries.en: The air here is teeming with magical energy. This might be the perfect place to let the great serpent do its business.
entries.fr: Vous sentez un courant d'air empreint d'une mystérieuse énergie. Peut-être qu'elle permettrait au Serpent marin de libérer sa lumière...
entries.ja:
神秘的な息吹を感じる場所だ。
水蛇様の力を解放するには最適かもしれない……。

entries.en: Speak with Uterl Matl at Hopl's Stopple to mount the Great Vessel of Ronka, and unleash its peculiar light into the area around Fruit of the Protector.
entries.fr: Si vous ne chevauchez plus la jarre du Serpent marin, allez parler à Uterl Matl au plateau de Hopl pour remonter dessus.

ホパル古盤の「ウテルリ・マトル」に話しかけ、
水蛇様の壺に騎乗し、「不思議な光」を放ってみよう。

I trust Uterl Matl's task was not too daunting...
Oh, I see! What an unorthodox request. However, it seems that Uterl Matl, and more importantly the great serpent, were more than pleased with your performance.

entries.en: Humble creatures such as we are can but guess as to the serpent's wishes, and carry them out as dutifully as we can manage. In that respect, I believe we have done splendidly!
entries.fr: Voies du Serpent marin être im<->pé<->né<->tra<->bles, mais Qhoterl Pasol n'avoir aucun douuute sur fait que Serpent marin savoir récompenser bonne action de fidèles<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ですが、水蛇様は超常の存在であられまする～。
きっと、わたくしどもでは計り知れない何かを察知し、
対処してくださったのでございましょ～！

So long as the great serpent is happy, the Qitari are happy─and that should make you happy, old <if(gnum4,chapette,chap)>!
